content.name: Restoring Touch
entries: When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: {@condition Blinded|SRD52}, {@condition Charmed|SRD52}, {@condition Deafened|SRD52}, {@condition Frightened|SRD52}, {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52}, or {@condition Stunned|SRD52}. You must expend 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} from the healing pool of Lay On Hands for each of these conditions you remove; those points don't also restore {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} to the creature.
